newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee trades flat, market liquid.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee trades flat, market liquid.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee held steady against the dollar in dull early trade on Monday with the market well supplied with dollars, dealers said.
At 0445 GMT, the rupee was at 58.48 to the greenback after opening at the same level. On Friday, the rupee closed at 58.49.
"There is excess liquidity in the market. For (the market) to trade in a range today, it will require a big bill," said an American Express Bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed the dollar down by 0.25 local cents and fixed buying and selling rates at 58.4744 and 59.6557, respectively.
Dealers said the dollar-rupee exchange rate should remain at current levels for the rest of the day.
Overnight call money, which opened at 9.75 percent, fell to 9.37 percent due to the high liquidity in the market, dealers said.
